name: Info strip
description: A compact bar for the edge of a screen: your logo, the time and date, the current weather and a rotating line of short announcements. Made for L-bars, bottom strips and side bars; it rearranges itself for a thin strip, a tall side column or a full screen. Nothing is fetched: weather comes from your own Weather data source.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: messages
params.label: Messages
params.help: One short message per line; they take turns. Start a line with a label and a | to show it as a tag, for example: Today | All-hands at 15:30. Leave empty to show only the clock and weather.
params.default:
Welcome | Visitors, please sign in at reception and collect your badge
Today | All-hands in the Atrium at 15:30, coffee and pastries from 15:00
Safety | Fire alarm test on Thursday at 11:00, no need to evacuate
Café | Soup of the day: roasted squash with sourdough, 4.50
Wi-Fi | Guest network Northwind-Guest, password at the front desk
Kudos | Congratulations to Priya Raman on ten years with the team

params.name: weather
params.label: Weather data source (optional)
params.help: A data source of type Weather (Data Sources → New → Weather). Leave empty to hide the weather.

params.name: location
params.label: Location name
params.help: Shown under the temperature where there is room. Leave empty to use the weather data source's own place name.

params.name: show_forecast
params.label: Show the next three days
params.help: Only in the side-bar and full-screen layouts, where there is room for it.

params.name: name
params.label: Organisation name
params.help: Shown beside the logo. Leave empty to show the logo alone.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A square or wide logo with a transparent background works best. Clear it to hide the logo.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: Weather words, date and number format, for example en-GB, de-DE or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: edge
params.label: Accent line
params.help: A thin accent-coloured line along the side that meets the main content.

options.label: Automatic (top of a strip, left of a side bar)

params.name: animate
params.label: Animate
params.help: Messages slide in and a thin bar shows when the next one is due. Turn off for very low-powered players.
